## About Me

I am a data and technology professional with a Master’s degree in Data Analytics Engineering from George Mason University and a background in computer science, cloud development, and business analytics.

Currently, I work as a Business Analyst at Saayam for All, where I contribute to business processes, data-driven initiatives, reporting, and cross-functional collaboration. Previously, I worked at Virtusa as an Associate Engineer, gaining hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, application development, APIs, and database technologies. I also served as a Graduate Teaching Assistant at George Mason University, supporting courses related to big data analytics, healthcare data, and health information technology.

My technical skill set includes Python, SQL, R, AWS, PostgreSQL, Tableau, Power BI, and Excel. I enjoy transforming complex data into meaningful insights, building analytical solutions, and using technology to solve real-world problems.

I am particularly interested in opportunities across data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, and business analysis, where I can combine technical expertise with analytical thinking to support better business decisions.
